why: A slow link no longer runs out the SSH login's wait while the helper uploads: the waiting login (which polls for its ready file every 0.2 s and gave up after 325 polls) now counts only polls more than 30 s after the received file last grew (`waited`, the spinner keeps `attempt`; `seen` and `grown` by the host's date +%s), and the app paces the upload by how much of it ssh takes rather than by the setup's 60 s. Text only: what the login answers is unchanged (no recorded login waited with an upload running past its limit), so the recorded login commands are rewritten. Recorded observations of a running ssh's arguments (results, and the ssh -G reads made from them) keep the old text, and the app only reads them.

replace.old:
now=$(date +%s)
    case "$now" in ""|*[!0-9]*) now=0;; esac
    if test -z "$since"; then mark=$got since=$now
replace.new:
now=$(date +%s)
    case "$now" in ""|*[!0-9]*) now=0;; esac
    test "$got" = "$seen" || seen=$got grown=$now
    test "$now" -gt 0 && test $((now - grown)) -lt 30 && waited=$((waited - 1))
    if test -z "$since"; then mark=$got since=$now

replace.old:
attempt=0 uploading=0 drawn=
  while test ! -e ready && test ! -L ready && test "$attempt" -lt 325; do
    sleep 0.2
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    progress
  done
replace.new:
attempt=0 waited=0 uploading=0 drawn=
  while test ! -e ready && test ! -L ready && test "$waited" -lt 325; do
    sleep 0.2
    attempt=$((attempt + 1)) waited=$((waited + 1))
    progress
  done
